build_dot_graph_from_objects: build a DOT graph string from root objects using print_graph with default child extraction
create_dot_builder: create a DotBuilder instance to programmatically construct a graphviz DOT digraph with nodes and edges
add_node_to_dot_graph: add a named node with a label and optional color to the DotBuilder graph
add_edge_to_dot_graph: add a labeled directed edge between two nodes in the DotBuilder graph with optional color
quote_dot_string: quote a string safely for DOT language output using smart_quote handling keywords and alphanumerics
